snippet.title: HANA - Pre Alpha Playtest Trailer
snippet.description: The pre-alpha playtest for Hana will be available to players on PC via Steam. It kicks off on Sunday, June 23, 2024, at 2 PM GMT+2 (8 AM EST) and will be available only on that day.
